chapter.verse: Zeisu in tua mun pan paikhia a, ama khua-ah pai-in a nungzuite in a zui uh hi.

Nipi ni a tun’ ciangin kikhopna innah thu a hilh hi. Mi tampite in a thu a zak uh ciangin, lamdang a sa uh hi. “Hih pa in hih thute koi pan a ngah hiam? Hih pa kipia pilna in bang pilna ahi hiam? Ama khut tawh hihzah tak nalamdangte bangci a bawl thei hiam?

Amah in Mari’ ta hilo ahi hiam? Khutsiampa ahi, Jakob, Josef, Judas leh Simon-te’ sanggampa hilo ahi hiam? Ama sanggamnute in i kiangah om hilo ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a gen uh hi. Amaute in ama hangin a lungkia uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian’ kamsangpa in ama inn, ama khua, ama behte kiangah longal mun dangah minthan’na ngah loin om lo hi,” ci-in amaute kiangah a ci hi.
Cina tawmte tungah khut nga a, a damsak sim loh, tua santakah nalamdang lian a bawl kei hi.
Amaute up lohna lamdang a sa hi. Zeisu in khuapite leh khuaneute sungah thuhilhin a vak kawikawi hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in a nungzui sawm-le-nihte a sap khit ciangin, kihhuai dawite a zawh nading thu pia a, nih tek, nih tekin a sawl hi.
“Note in ciangkhut khat sim loh, lampi ah zat ding a dang bangmah na keng kei un. Khomun, thungip, kawnggak sungah dangkasan na vom kei un.
Khedap bulh un la, puanak na silh thuah kei un.
Inn khat peuhah na lut uh leh, tua khua pan na paikhiat matengun tua innah va om un.

Mun khat peuhah mite in hong nolh a, na thu uh a ngaih kei uh leh, amau omna pan na paikhiat uh ciangin, amau lang khatah teci pang dingin, na khepeek nuai uh ah leivuite na singkhia un,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Tuate paikhia uh a, mite mawhna kisik nading thuhilhin,
dawi tampi hawlkhia uh a, cidam lo mi tampi sathau tawh zutin a damsak uh hi.

Tua lai takin Herod kumpipa in tua thu za hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Zeisu min a thang hi. “Baptaizpa Johan in sihna pan a thokik zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin, hih vangliatna in ama tungah a kilang hi,” a ci uh hi.
Mi kimkhat in, “Hih mi in Elijah ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Midangte in, “Tanglai kamsangte khatpeuh tawh kibang, kamsangpa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Herod in a zak ciangin, “A ngawng ka tansak Johan a thokik zo hi,” a ci hi.
Herod in a nau Filip’ zi Herodias thu hangin Johan a matsak khit ciangin, thong sungah a hen hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Herod in tua Herodias tawh a kiteen’ ciangin,
Johan in, “Na nau’ zi teen’pih ding kilawm lo hi,” ci-in Herod kiangah a gen hi.
Herodias in Johan mudah a, a that nuam hangin that zo lo hi.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Johan in mi thuman, mi siangthopa ahih Herod in thei ahih ciangin, Johan kihta a, amah a kem hi. Amah in Johan thu a zak ciangin lungmang a, lungdamna tawh ama thu a ngai hi.
Tua nung ciangin a kilawm ni tung a, Herod’ suah ni-in a upate, galkap mangte, leh Galile gam za liante an a vak hi.
Tua lai takin Herodias’ tanu lutin a laam ciangin, Herod akipan amah tawh an a nekhawmte a nuam uh hi. Herod in, “Na deih peuhpeuh hong ngen in kong pia ding hi,” ci-in numeino thu a pia hi.
Khatvei, “Na hong nget khempeuh ka gam langkhat dongin kong pia ding hi,” ci-in thu a ciam hi.
Numeino in paikhia a “Bang ka ngen ding hiam?” ci-in a nu a dot ciangin a nu in, “Baptaizpa Johan’ lutang ngen in,” a ci hi.
Numeino thakhatin kumpipa kiangah tum a, “Baptaizpa Johan’ lutang dalkuang sungah hong pia le-cin ka ut hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa a dah mahmah hangin, a kiciam zawhna leh sabuai ah a tut khawmpihte a zahtak manin numeino a nial nuam kei hi.
“Johan’ lutang hong paipih in,” ci-in galkap khat a sawl ciangin tua pa pai a, thong sungah Johan’ ngawng a tan khit ciangin,
dalkuang sungah a lutang paipih a, tua numeino a piak khit ciangin numeino in a nu a pia hi.
Johan’ nungzuite in a zak uh ciangin pai uh a, a luang paipihin hankhuk sungah a vui uh hi.
Sawltakte in Zeisu kiangah kikhawm uh a, a hihna khempeuh leh a thuhilhna khempeuh a zasak uh hi.

Zeisu in, “Gam daihna-ah hong pai un la, tomkha tawldam na’ngin khawl un,” a ci hi. Bang hangin hih bangin a gen hiam i cih leh, mi tampite in a vak a ciah uh ahih ciangin, amau in an ne man lo zawzenin a om uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, gunkuang tungah tuangin gamlak gam daihna-ah a pai uh hi.
A pai lai takun mite in mu uh a, kimkhat in amaute ahih lam a theih uh ciangin, khuapi khempeuh panin paikhia uh a, tai-in a tung masa uh hi.
Zeisu paikhia a, mihonpi a muh ciangin, a cing om lo tuute tawh kibang hi ci-in hehpihhuai sa a, thu tampi a hilh hi.
Ni a tum dektak ciangin a nungzuite Topa kiangah va pai uh a, “Hih lai tak in gamlak ahi hi. Ni lah a tum zo hi.
Amaute a kimkot khuaneu leh lo lai-ah pai-in an nek ding lei dingin paisak ta in,” a cih uh leh,
Zeisu in, “Amau nek ding an note’n na pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Kote pai-in dangka zakhat tawh khomun ka lei khit uh ciangin, amaute nek dingin ka pia ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khomun pum bangzah na nei uh hiam? Pai un la, va en un,” a ci hi. Amaute in a theih khit uh ciangin, “Khomun pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih a om hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Mi khempeuh lopa hing tungah a pawlpawlin tusak un,” a ci hi.
Amaute in pawlkhat za, pawlkhat sawmnga, a pawlpawlin a tu uh hi.

Zeisu in khomun nga leh ngasa tawn nih la a, vantung lam ento-in hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, khomun balnenin mite mai-ah lui dingin a nungzuite a pia hi. Ngasa tawn nih zong amaute khempeuh lakah a hawmsak hi.
Mi khempeuh in a ne uh a,
a kham khit uh ciangin khomun leh ngasa, a neng a themte khawm uh a, seeng sawm leh seeng nih dim a ngah uh hi.
Khomun a ne pasal bek tul nga a pha hi.
Zeisu in mihonte a paikhiatsak lai takin, a nungzuite gunkuang ah thakhatin tuangsakin, a gal khat Bethsaida khua-ah ama mai-ah a paisak hi.
Zeisu in mihonpite tawh a kikhen khit ciangin, thungen dingin mual tungah a kahto hi.
Nitak ciangin gunkuang in tuili lai zangah a om hi. Zeisu ahih leh, lei tungah amah guakin a om hi.

A deih lohna uh lam panin huih in lehmut ahih ciangin, a nungzuite in gunkuang hot a gim mahmah a om uh Zeisu in mu a, khua vak dektak nai thum ciangin tuili tungah amaute kiangah pai a, a pel ding bangin a pai hi.
Ahih hangin tuipi tungah a pai amaute in a muh uh ciangin sikha sa-in a kiko uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute khempeuh in Zeisu mu uh a, a lau uh hi. Ahih hangin Zeisu in, “Na lungdam ta un, keimah ka hi hi. Na lau kei un,” a ci pah hi.
Gunkuang tungah amaute kiangah a kahtoh ciangin huihnung dai hi. Amaute in a lungsim sung uh ah lamdang a sa uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amau lungsim uh pil lo ahih ciangin khomun thu ciamteh lo uh hi.
Tui gal khatah a kah khit uh ciangin, Gennesareth gamah a tung uh a, gunkuang tui geiah a khawlsak uh hi.
Amaute in gunkuang sung pan a paikhiat uh ciangin mite khempeuh in Zeisu’ meel a thei uh hi.
A kimkot gam khempeuh ah tai-in, koi lai takah a om ci-in a zak uh ciangin tua munah mi cinate lupna tawh a paipih uh hi.
Khuapi, khuaneu, gamlak, a tun’na khempeuh ah cidam lo mite lam kiangah a koih uh a, ama puan mong teep beek a lawn’ nadingun a ngen uh hi. Amah a lawng khempeuh in cidamna a ngah uh hi.
